name: device-studio.launch-video-shot
purpose: Save and reopen one immutable Device Studio shot revision, submit or inspect its owner render job, and hand the verified export to Launch Video.
assumptions: The caller supplies a project and source-media IDs already owned by Device Studio.
The shot snapshot and render idempotency key are immutable for a given submission.
A render job is asynchronous; each invocation performs one owner request and one bounded read, never a private polling loop.
invariants: Save uses the caller's expected shot revision and never retries a conflicting save.
Submission pins the exact revision returned by SaveShot and uses the caller's stable idempotency key.
Observe and cancel address only the supplied project and render job; cancellation uses the owner's expected version.
Only a succeeded owner job yields an export command; the existing CLI verifies and publishes the bytes.
A timeout or transport error is reported as an uncertain owner outcome with the same identity required for reconciliation.

signals.shot: Project, shot, exact revision, recipe/source identity and reopened immutable revision.
signals.render: Owner job status, version, output profile, verified output metadata and opaque content URL when available.
signals.next_command: Owner CLI command to export a succeeded job to a new local path.
signals.recovery: Same job/idempotency identity to observe or cancel after an uncertain response.

outputs.evidence: Exact owner project/shot/revision/job IDs, revisions, recipe and media digests, and output digest.
